ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What stage comes between eggs and molt in the life cycle of a cicada?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circular diagram of a cicada life cycle, with green curved arrows connecting several stages. On the left is a group of eggs, labeled C beside it; at the top is a juvenile cicada form without wings, labeled A beside it; on the right is a form that is molting or coming out of the old shell, labeled F beside it; at the bottom is a winged adult, labeled E beside it. Reasoning: The question asks about the stage between eggs and molt. Along the life cycle, continuing from the eggs on the left to before the molting image on the right, the juvenile cicada stage at the top appears in between. This juvenile stage is called nymph.
